ModMetaData.description:
Mech-Exosuit Framework: exosuit meccanoid-guidate con subcore vanilla come pilota interno.
[Status: M0 — Hello World Mech] This is the very first milestone. It only adds a single test mech-exosuit (Patriot placeholder) that can be spawned via dev mode. None of the core features (subcore pilot, battery, bay, etc.) are implemented yet — those come in M1-M7.
Required mods: - Exosuit Framework (aoba.exosuit.framework) - Harmony (brrainz.harmony)
Roadmap: - M0 (this) — Hello World Mech: spawn a custom mech-exosuit via dev mode - M1 — Subcore Install: CompSubcorePilot + HP tracking - M2 — Death & Relic: drop sealed relic, deterministic recovery - M3 — Bay Ibrida: Building_HybridGestator with 4 functions - M4 — Batteria & Bandwidth: low power mode, charging - M5 — SubcoreInfo Integration: identity propagation - M6 — CE Compat: Combat Extended patches - M7 — Polish & Bilanciamento: playtesting, textures, release
